scope: CVG-004 local two-account concurrent one-shot scheduled Cheques worker scope

criteria.description: The disposable process fixture contains two accounts, distinct persisted check payments and schedules, and account-mapped non-interactive report service principals.
criteria.limitations: The fixture is local and synthetic; it does not prove production provisioning or target roles.

criteria.description: Two real run-once worker processes complete concurrently and each persisted execution contains exactly the cheque payment belonging to its own account.
criteria.limitations: The evidence covers one one-shot process per account, not the continuous worker topology.

criteria.description: No execution for account A contains account B's payment or vice versa, as checked by an inverse-payment query after both workers finish.
criteria.limitations: No claim is made for direct SQL/admin bypasses or a target cluster.

criteria.description: The complete scheduled-report process boundary remains green after the two-account assertion is added.
criteria.limitations: The full file remains a local disposable PostgreSQL process proof.

gaps: Continuous multi-account worker topology, target RLS/roles, remote CI, external delivery, providers, restore/RTO-RPO, remaining report families, global parity and release acceptance remain open.
conditions: Keep the result limited to the local one-shot scheduled financial-cheques report source.
Do not infer production readiness, target behavior, provider delivery or release acceptance from this gate.
Revalidate before broadening scheduled worker topology or adding provider/external behavior.
